done_when: Close starts the review at the same time as its tests, so a round takes about as long as the slower of the two; a red test or a P0/P1 finding still stops the round, and both results are reported together. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The standard requires: “Tests own and clean up every process they start, even after a crash; detect and fail on leftover processes when a test worker crashes.” On a 90-second timeout, this test kills only the `forge close` parent. The test command and Autoreview are launched in separate process groups (`review.test_run` and `review._attempt`), so a hung child can remain running after the test fails. The test neither stops those children nor checks for leftovers.
findings.title: Standard: Tests own and clean up every process they start

why: Close waits for tests to finish before it starts the review
